title: customer-initiated-data-erasure-certification-and-control-plane-verification
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Goal: Deliver a customer-facing, verifiable data erasure flow that ties a self-service Right-To-Be-Forgotten (RTBF) request to an immutable control-plane confirmation (certificate/ledger entry) and a downloadable evidence bundle. Scope includes the API surface for initiating erasure, backend orchestrator for coordinated tenant-scoped deletes, automatic verification checks, and the UI/CLI for certificate download.

Background: Customers have asked for a short, auditable proof that their deletion requests completed across hosted and Dedicated environments (VPC). Existing work covers purge orchestration and export but lacks a single customer-facing certificate and a verification handshake between storage, job runner, and control-plane audit ledger. This ticket bridges that gap and automates evidence creation for compliance audits.

Non-goals: This ticket does not add new cryptographic key management for evidence signing (we will integrate KMS in a follow-up) and does not modify retention engine policies; it only reads retention status and triggers erasure flows where allowed.

Success criteria: 1) Customers can trigger or request an RTBF deletion and receive a downloadable PDF/JSON certificate containing a unique deletion ID, timestamp, geographic scope, and verification hashes. 2) Internal audit UI surfaces a verification status per deletion ID and links raw evidence bundles. 3) End-to-end automated tests validate deletion across at least two storage backends and the control-plane ledger.

Stakeholders: Privacy/legal (Anika Roy), Security (Marco Alvarez), Storage (ENG-1627), Jobs/Orchestrator (ENG-1980), Console (ENG-2043), Support (Lara Nguyen).
acceptance_criteria: RTBF API endpoint accepts tenant-scoped deletion requests and returns a deletion_id
Orchestrator emits a control-plane ledger entry within 60s of job completion
Certificate generation service packages verification metadata and a signed hash (placeholder)
Customer console shows deletion_id status and allows download of certificate and raw evidence bundle
Automated CI job runs a simulated tenant deletion against a staging S3 and Postgres and asserts ledger consistency
